text:
leo: spontaneous idea  lunchtime penalty shootout in the courtyard on Friday? small World Cup qualifier sweepstakes too. $2 to enter, winner gets playlist control for a week + a mystery jersey swap. anyone in? :soccer:
anya: love it. i can referee (mostly impartial). when exactly is lunch this week?
bryce: i'm in for $2 and the jersey chaos. also bringing a handful of cones.
maggie: question: are we doing actual goalies or just shooting for time? i'm garbage at GK.
leo: thinking 3v3 shootout format: 3 shooters each team, rotating goalies allowed. keep it fast  12:15-12:45.
chuck: i volunteer as emergency goalie. low expectations. also will bring bandaids.
eventsbot: Poll created by leo: "Penalty shootout format" Options: 1) 3v3 shootout (rotating GKs) 2) Solo shootout (everyone for themselves) 3) Just watch. React with :one:, :two:, :three:.
anya: :one: fair and quick.
bryce: :two: selfish energy but ok.
maggie: :one: team vibes.
eventsbot: Poll closed. Results: 1) 3v3 - 3 votes, 2) Solo - 1 vote, 3) Watch - 0 votes. Outcome: 3v3 shootout.
leo: sweet. sign-up sheet: https://tiny.redwood/courtyard-shootout (name / team preference / paid?y/n). $2 cash to bryce or Venmo @bryce-kicks.
chuck: safety note: courtyard concrete, so cleats discouraged. sneakers only. also watch for delivery trucks.\bryce: paid via Venmo. team name suggestion: Debug FC.
maggie: paid cash on my desk. team name: Merge Commit United.
anya: i'll bring whistles and a tiny manual scoreboard. i'm excited about playlist control.\leo: raffle rules: each $2 entry = 1 raffle ticket for the jersey swap. winner picks someone to swap jerseys with (consent required). jersey must be office-appropriate.\bryce: consent clause noted. also side-bet: loser does a soccer chant in Monday standup.\maggie: we should have a tiebreaker: sudden-death shootout until someone misses.
eventsbot: Reminder posted: Courtyard Shootout Fri 12:15-12:45. Safety: sneakers only, bring water.\leo: last logistics: photographers (i mean, documentarians) welcome. keep it PG. also if it rains we'll move to the parking lot futsal strip.\chuck: i'll bring first-aid kit and a small bluetooth speaker. low-volume hype.\anya: scoreboard and playlist sorted. see you all Friday. may the best kicker win. :soccer: :trophy:
